scope: One hosted guest T08 subtarget for no-signal SEO and empty Schema panes on an owned localhost fixture at 600px CDP-emulated width.

case.fixture: Owned localhost page with title only and no body, SEO metadata, links, images, headings or JSON-LD.
verified_substeps: Initial active Scrape state had no result tablist or selected result tab.

A trusted click reached the active Scrape capture control and the fresh-capture predicate passed; its conditions require the active visible Article result pane, selected inside Scrape, with the fixture title.
The visible selected SEO pane showed the expected title, an empty description marker, and only the Title & description and Performance groups.
The visible selected Schema pane contained valid JSON with the expected title, absent description/canonical, and zero Open Graph, Twitter, schema type, and JSON-LD entries.
Capture identity and digest remained unchanged after each of the SEO and Schema panes.
case.article_ready_evidence_note: The runner does not serialize the post-capture ready state object separately. Its successful exit and status=pass require `isCaptureReady` to pass after a trusted click; that predicate checks selected active visible Article, containment within active Scrape, result pane visibility, and matching title. Independent reviewer confirmed this is sufficient bounded evidence; the limitation remains explicit.

independent_review.summary: Reviewer independently verified provenance, valid resource finals, 600px CDP width, trusted click and Article readiness predicate, exact SEO/Schema values, and stable capture identity/digest. No broader T08 or physical resize claim.

next_action: Credit only the bounded guest T08 no-signal SEO and empty Schema subtarget. Keep the overall Scrape result-tabs test partial; member/admin, physical resize, Store-installed behavior, and full T08 remain unverified.
